name: supersede-slice
context_rationale: Supersede-slice operates on named archived and active slice folders using a provided slice ID argument; the file-manipulation steps are delegable.
summary: Establishes a formal bidirectional supersession link between an archived slice whose design has been contradicted by reality and a new active slice that fixes it, per SUP-1. Appends a Supersession section to the archived reflection.json, updates the active slice's mission-brief.json frontmatter, updates _index.json to mark the archived row as superseded, and validates the link via supersede_audit.

reads.purpose: List available archived slice IDs when target not found (Glob fallback)

outputs.purpose: Append ## Supersession section (append-only; no other content modified)
Add Supersedes: <archived-slice-id> to frontmatter to close bidirectional link
Mark archived slice row as superseded by active slice in the catalog table (vault_edit rewrite CAS, ADR-088)

tools.name: supersede_audit
tools.purpose: Validate bidirectional supersession link consistency — both archived reflection.md and active mission-brief.md must reference each other (Step 5)

tools.name: vault_edit
tools.purpose: Read-modify-write _index.md to mark archived slice row as superseded (Step 6, R-32 CAS ADR-088)

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read archived slice reflection.json to surface one-line summary; read active slice mission-brief.json to update frontmatter

harness_tools.name: Edit
harness_tools.purpose: Append Supersession section to archived reflection.json; add Supersedes field to active mission-brief.json frontmatter

harness_tools.name: Glob
harness_tools.purpose: List available archived slices when target ID is not found

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Validate archived slice directory exists; run supersede_audit
